description: You are the executor of an estate and must prepare an asset inventory for probate court. Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/estate_inventory_raw.xlsx containing disorganized asset data from gathered documents. Transform it into a proper inventory with columns: Asset Description, Gross Value, Liens/Debts, Net Value, Verification Status, and Asset Category. Add a TOTALS section calculating Total Gross Assets, Total Liens/Debts, and Net Estate Value. Add a BENEFICIARY DISTRIBUTION section showing 4 beneficiaries and their equal shares (Net Estate / 4). Use formulas for all calculations. Apply professional formatting suitable for court filing. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
